decisions.decision: Output-only BusesProperties (no input bus) to enforce strict synth contract
decisions.rationale: IS_SYNTH TRUE plugins must not declare input buses; pluginval strictness 10 + auval both verify this; matches Ouaricon synth-plugin pattern
alternatives: Default BusesProperties with input (would fail strict synth contract)

decisions.decision: setLatencySamples(0) in prepareToPlay; do NOT override getLatencySamples()
decisions.rationale: AudioProcessor::getLatencySamples() is non-virtual in JUCE 8 (CLAUDE.md memory); attempting to override compiles silently but never fires. Stage 2 will update the value at prepareToPlay once oversampling latency is known.
alternatives: Override getLatencySamples() (broken in JUCE 8 — silent no-op)

decisions.decision: Wire scala-tuning-engine via Pattern B (target_sources) and note-expression via Pattern A (ouaricon_add_module) at Stage 1
decisions.rationale: Locks the build-system surface area now so Stage 2 (Phase 2.6) can call the modules without revisiting CMake. note-expression module patches the JUCE VST3 client; deferring its inclusion to Stage 2 risks a mid-stage CMake regeneration.
alternatives: Defer module wiring to Stage 2 (forces mid-stage CMake refactor)

decisions.decision: Both NEEDS_WEBVIEW2 TRUE and JUCE_USE_WIN_WEBVIEW2_WITH_STATIC_LINKING=1 set at Stage 1
decisions.rationale: Avoids the WebView silent-blank-page bug on Windows (CLAUDE.md memory: dynamic loader looks for WebView2Loader.dll which is not distributed). Stage 3 GUI will use WebView; baking the flags in early prevents a Stage 3 build-system regression.
alternatives: Add flags later at Stage 3 (risks shipping a blank-page WebView build)
